groups.title: Simple adverbial modification
groups.proposal: Compose first- and second-degree adverbial modification from exact principal and adjoined Results.
groups.readingJob: Show relation, degree, order, domain, compared-manner contrast, and finite Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Relation, degree, and order are genuine choices only where the captured units license them.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize a relation from translation, lesson labels, formulas, or surfaces.

groups.title: Multiple-nucleus modification
groups.proposal: Allow one simple adjunction to contain multiple nucleus units while preserving adjectival, supplementary, and combined structure.
groups.readingJob: Show each captured nucleus, its structural role, and the combined Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Users capture units and choose a licensed profile; multiplicity follows the exact structure.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not flatten multiple nuclei into one stored string.

groups.title: Head recursion and interrogative recursion
groups.proposal: Continue exact adjunction Results recursively at the head and preserve inherent or particle-supported interrogative force.
groups.readingJob: Show the inner Result, outer relation, recursion site, interrogative source, and retained force.
groups.decisionSplit: Recursion is licensed by exact Result identity; interrogative force is derived from typed structure.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not recurse over copied Results or infer interrogativity from punctuation.

groups.title: Modifier recursion and collocations
groups.proposal: Build recursive modifier structures and particle-adverbial collocations without treating traditional solid spelling as syntactic fusion.
groups.readingJob: Show recursive scope, particle role, negative scope, spelling convention, and compositional translation.
groups.decisionSplit: Typed units and scope are choices; spelling and translation are readings.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not let traditional spelling or English word order authorize structure.

groups.title: Intensifier profiles
groups.proposal: Apply licensed intensifier profiles to exact adverbial structures while retaining their scope and polarity.
groups.readingJob: Show intensifier identity, scope, polarity, relation, and unchanged inner Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The intensifier is selectable only where its captured structure licenses it.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize lexical intensifier readings into unrestricted grammar.

groups.title: Modifier-internal recursion and apposition
groups.proposal: Keep modifier-internal recursion distinct from apposition and conjunction while composing each through exact captured Results.
groups.readingJob: Show recursion site, appositional relation, conjunction contrast, and structural boundaries.
groups.decisionSplit: The relation is a genuine choice where more than one owner-licensed analysis remains.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not collapse apposition and conjunction because their surfaces resemble one another.

groups.title: Recursion on both sides
groups.proposal: Allow recursive structure in both principal and modifying units when both are exact canonical Results.
groups.readingJob: Show both inner histories, their attachment sites, order, and the resulting outer relation.
groups.decisionSplit: Outer choices never reconstruct either inner derivation.
groups.controlPolicy: Reject copied, JSON-restored, formula-derived, and surface-derived inner frames.

groups.title: Adverbial units as principal structures
groups.proposal: Permit adverbial nuclear clauses and NNCs to serve as principal units, including interrogative and adjunctor-supported variants.
groups.readingJob: Show clause rank, interrogative upgrade, adjunctor, included force, and finite projection.
groups.decisionSplit: Clause rank and licensed adjunctor are choices; force loss or retention follows the typed construction.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer principal rank from capitalization, translation, or display position.
